summary: Comprehensive testing of Retention Plays (Churn -> System of Action). Created pytest suite covering all 4 endpoints + org scoping: 17/17 backend tests passed. Frontend loop verified end-to-end: Protect dialog -> action-support -> AI drafted content (2423 chars) -> Mark saved -> Revenue Protected metric updated ($15k -> $110k, +$95k Tyrell Corp).

minor.issue: AI generation via LlmChat occasionally exceeds a 60s client-side timeout on re-runs. The server itself uses asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=40) and falls back to template on failure. When running the parametric create-all-4-actions test back-to-back sequentially, one occasional client timeout was observed on 'workflow'. Full first run (17/17) passed cleanly. Consider raising client-side timeouts in production usage or streaming responses.

issues: React hydration/DOM nesting warnings (console): '<span> cannot be a child of <tr>/<td>/<tbody>' and '<th> span' in the Cohort Retention Analysis table (span badges nested improperly). Non-functional but pollutes the console. Likely stems from lines ~572-586 where Badge/span elements are rendered inside <tr>/<td>. Should wrap correctly.
